transcript.text: Hi, I'm with the Department of Labor. How can I help you today?
I still have not received my unemployment check for last week.
I can help you check the status of your unemployment payment. To get started, I'll need to verify your identity. Could you please provide your first name, last name, and date of birth?
Sure — my name is Linus Turing and my date of birth is June 23, 1988.

I've checked the status of your unemployment payment, but I couldn't find any information about a payment for last week. This may be due to a processing delay or an issue with your claim. I recommend contacting the Department of Labor directly for further assistance. Would you like me to transfer you to a representative who can help?
No thanks on a transfer for now. My claim reference is INC0010123 — can you tell me the status of that claim and why last week's payment didn't come through?

I've checked the status of your claim with reference number INC0010123, but I couldn't find any information about it in our system. This may be due to a processing delay or an issue with your claim. I recommend contacting the Department of Labor directly for further assistance. Would you like me to transfer you to a representative who can help?
